payload.title: Run live rounds 2-3 for F, F-rand, A-c and A-c+F and freeze the protocol (S4)
payload.description:
## Purpose

Run live rounds 2–3 for F, F-rand, A-c and A-c+F on dev-100 and freeze versions and protocol for the final run (stop S4).

## Scope

Round-1 catch-up for A-c / A-c+F (≈400 zero-shot), then rounds 2–3 for all four arms (≈1,750 few-shot + ≈1,200 zero-shot), about 6 analyst calls with L2 comments. Same corpus, label order (seed 1), rounds, dev-100, gate, folds and leakage rules as the unified study.

## Cost cap

≈$1.75 Jev; **hard cap 3,400 Jev requests** for this step; cumulative ledger ≤7,500. Pre-approved within these caps.

## Definition of done (S4)

Dev-100 table for all arms with Brier/accuracy, the analyst's proposed questions, which comments each promoted element cited, and actual spend; humans look; the frozen versions and the final protocol are written in `studies/` before any paper-600 request.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §5.2, §5.3, §6 step 8.
